g.text: B. Curb alone (at 100 % no curb is left)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2428

g.text: Snow-loading nights: modelled automobiles as a share of places, area by area

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Grey: an ordinary night. Blue, light to dark: the night the area's own streets are under a loading ban, if the ban takes 25 %, 50 % (central case)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: or 100 % of its legal curb that night. Which streets are loaded on which night is not published: these are assumptions, not observations.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: A share of places compares capacity, not occupancy; registered automobiles stand in for overnight demand.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Places: legal curb at 5.25 m (measured, upper bound) and private places of buildings of five dwellings or fewer (measured, calibrated on a street-level check).

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Nights a winter: full loading operations in the area's sector (≥ 100 truckloads), mean of the five winters 2021–22 to 2025–26, two nights an operation at 50 %. Hatched: most households in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: buildings of six dwellings or more, whose garages are not counted. City of Montréal, snow-removal transactions and sectors (CC BY 4.0).

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Sources: SAAQ, vehicles released under the access Act (file 03.06.34729), December 31, 2024, type inferred; Statistics Canada, 2021 Census;

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: City of Montréal, géobase, parking-sign inventory and assessment roll (CC BY 4.0). Automobiles below the FSA are MODELLED, not measured.
